verses.text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God; I shall seek You earnestly; My soul thirsts for You, my flesh yearns for You, In a dry and weary land where there is no water.
verses.textZh: （大衛在猶大曠野的時候，作了這詩。）神啊，你是我的神，我要切切地尋求你，在乾旱疲乏無水之地，我渴想你；我的心切慕你。

verses.text: Thus I have seen You in the sanctuary, To see Your power and Your glory.
verses.textZh: 我在聖所中曾如此瞻仰你，為要見你的能力和你的榮耀。

verses.text: Because Your lovingkindness is better than life, My lips will praise You.
verses.textZh: 因你的慈愛比生命更好，我的嘴唇要頌讚你。

verses.text: So I will bless You as long as I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.
verses.textZh: 我還活的時候要這樣稱頌你；我要奉你的名舉手。

verses.text: My soul is satisfied as with marrow and fatness, And my mouth offers praises with joyful lips.
verses.textZh: 我在床上記念你，在夜更的時候思想你；我的心就像飽足了骨髓肥油，我也要以歡樂的嘴唇讚美你。

verses.text: When I remember You on my bed, I meditate on You in the night watches,
For You have been my help, And in the shadow of Your wings I sing for joy.
verses.textZh: 因為你曾幫助我，我就在你翅膀的蔭下歡呼。

verses.text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
verses.textZh: 我心緊緊地跟隨你；你的右手扶持我。

verses.text: But those who seek my life to destroy it, Will go into the depths of the earth.
verses.textZh: 但那些尋索要滅我命的人必往地底下去；

verses.text: They will be delivered over to the power of the sword; They will be a prey for foxes.
verses.textZh: 他們必被刀劍所殺，被野狗所吃。

verses.text: But the king will rejoice in God; Everyone who swears by Him will glory, For the mouths of those who speak lies will be stopped.
verses.textZh: 但是王必因神歡喜。凡指著他發誓的必要誇口，因為說謊之人的口必被塞住。
